rationale: The assistant correctly decoded Er FF as a freezer fan error, linked the scraping and rear frost to an iced evaporator fan, and recommended a full unplugged defrost with towels, no chipping, and clear food-safety guidance, matching the hidden truth exactly. When the customer set limits (6-8 hours, no panel removal) it adapted realistically, gave an honest 'borderline' assessment, a listen-for-scraping test, and a repeat-session fallback, and correctly flagged defrost-system or fan-motor failure for an engineer only if the code returns. 'Almost certainly' ice is slightly strong but consistent with the evidence; no parts were pushed and warranty/LG service were appropriately raised.
